upload_intents_object_key_check.name: upload_intents_object_key_check
upload_intents_object_key_check.value: length("upload_intents"."object_key") BETWEEN length("upload_intents"."workspace_id") + 2 AND 1029 AND substr("upload_intents"."object_key", 1, length("upload_intents"."workspace_id") + 1) = "upload_intents"."workspace_id" || '/'

upload_intents_lease_check.name: upload_intents_lease_check
upload_intents_lease_check.value: ("upload_intents"."status" = 'pending' AND "upload_intents"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("upload_intents"."status" <> 'pending' AND "upload_intents"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

upload_intents_error_check.name: upload_intents_error_check
upload_intents_error_check.value: ("upload_intents"."status" = 'cleanup_pending' AND length("upload_intents"."last_error_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 64) OR ("upload_intents"."status" <> 'cleanup_pending' AND "upload_intents"."last_error_code" IS NULL)

workspace_maintenance_reset_state_check.name: workspace_maintenance_reset_state_check
workspace_maintenance_reset_state_check.value: "workspace_maintenance_sessions"."purpose" = 'seed' OR ("workspace_maintenance_sessions"."mode" IN ('clean','demo') AND length("workspace_maintenance_sessions"."operation_id") = 36 AND "workspace_maintenance_sessions"."status" IN ('running','failed','completed') AND ("workspace_maintenance_sessions"."response_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("workspace_maintenance_sessions"."response_json") = 1))

workspace_reset_lease_check.name: workspace_reset_lease_check
workspace_reset_lease_check.value: ("workspace_reset_operations"."status" = 'failed' AND "workspace_reset_operations"."lease_token" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_reset_operations"."status" IN ('running','completed') AND length("workspace_reset_operations"."lease_token") BETWEEN 32 AND 128)
